landing_awaiting_invitation: Your account doesn't have access yet. Open the invitation link you were sent, and sign in with the email address it was sent to.
landing_invitation_only: Access is by invitation. Sign in to continue.
landing_headline: Every course has a story. Students tell it here.
landing_pitch: Ask before you enroll, share what you learned, and keep a record of where you've been, on your terms.
landing_footer: A student project · built with MongoDB

reviews_empty: No reviews yet. Be the first to share your experience.

thread_replies_load_failed: Replies couldn't be loaded. Try again.

history_refresh_failed: Couldn't refresh your history. Showing what was loaded earlier.
history_empty_detail: Add the courses you're planning, taking, or took. Taking or Took lets you review a course later.
course_picker_load_failed: Courses couldn't be loaded. Try again.
course_picker_school_empty: This school has no courses yet.

history_form_private_note_hint: · optional · only you ever see this

onboarding_no_schools_administrator: No schools have been added yet. Load the demo catalog to start.

person_own_profile_notice: This is how other students see your profile.
person_history_attribution: Self-reported by {displayName}. Schools don't verify these entries.
person_history_refresh_failed: Couldn't refresh this history. Showing what was loaded earlier.

admin_invitations_pending_explanation: Every invitation that can still be redeemed.
admin_invitations_pending_truncated: Only the newest {count} pending invitations are shown.
admin_invitations_recent_explanation: The latest invitations that were used, revoked, or expired.
admin_invitations_recent_empty: No used, revoked, or expired invitations yet.
profile_language_explanation: Saved in this browser. Course posts and reviews stay in the language they were written in.

error_invalid_input: Check what you entered and try again.

validation_profile_change_required: Change the display name or the school visibility.
error_page_not_found_detail: Check the address, or go to the home page.
